usage.callShape: POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/images/generations with JSON body {model, prompt, n, size}
usage.outputShape: body.data[0].url (BlockRun-hosted PNG); also body.data[0].source_url (original z.ai PNG, watermarked). body.created = unix timestamp.
quirks: Settlement can transiently fail: first paid attempt returned 402 with 'Payment settlement failed: ... unable to estimate gas' and paid:false (no charge). A retry with the identical body succeeded — treat this gas-estimation error as transient and retry once.
OpenAI-compatible images/generations shape: required fields are model='zai/cogview-4' and prompt. size (e.g. '1024x1024') supported up to 2048px.
Result is returned synchronously (no async job/polling). Use body.data[0].url for the BlockRun-hosted image; source_url is the original z.ai image and is watermarked.
x402 paid endpoint, no API key / no SIWX needed.
usage.guide: Send POST https://blockrun.ai/api/v1/images/generations with JSON {"model":"zai/cogview-4","prompt":"<your prompt>","n":1,"size":"1024x1024"} and pay the x402 quote (~$0.016) — no API key needed. The response is synchronous; read the generated image from body.data[0].url (BlockRun-hosted PNG). If the first paid call fails at settlement with an 'unable to estimate gas' error (paid:false, status 402), it is a transient base-chain issue — retry the same request once.
